Compute Camera

Source: R/camera_method.R
compute_camera.Rd

This internal function computes the actual hits using the camera method.

Usage

compute_camera(xglm, DGEList, matrix_model, contrast, number_barcode = 3)

Arguments

xglm

object created with estimateDisp

DGEList

edgeR object

...

Arguments passed on to find_camera_hit

matrix_model

The design matrix of the linear model, for example created with create_design_matrix (or with model.matrix). Rows must be named with sample identifiers in object order (see create_design_matrix); mismatched names or order are errors. Named contrast coefficients are aligned to design columns.

contrast

The comparison to test: the name or index of a column of matrix_model, a numeric contrast vector (for example created with create_contrast) or a one-column matrix created with makeContrasts.

number_barcode

Only genes with more than number_barcode barcodes are tested (default 3, so a gene needs at least 4 barcodes). The barcodes of a gene are tested together as a set, so this is not a number of barcodes that must change.

Value

The list of hits found by the camera method
